title: Scheduled BLS CPI release-day full-UTC-day BTC risk veto
thesis: The complete UTC day containing a preregistered BLS CPI release may have worse BTC return and path risk than same-window non-event days with the same weekdays because an inflation update can reprice expected policy, discount rates and cross-asset liquidity.
mechanism: A calendar-known CPI release concentrates uncertainty around an 08:30 Eastern information shock, which may increase downside incidence or intraday drawdown in BTC even though the surprise direction is unknown and an adversarial Bitcoin-macro prior predicts unstable responses.
economic_rationale: A spot-only policy that exits BTC at 00:00 UTC on each frozen CPI release date and reenters at the next 00:00 UTC is useful only if avoided event-day losses and drawdown exceed two fee-and-adverse-slippage transitions per event and the opportunity cost of foregone positive event-day returns under matched capital.
